scene.note: Departures.java turns the next crossing's values into true or false answers, and decides what the board says and what each passenger pays.

steps.note: The clipboard has the passengers booked and the seats on the boat.
Comparing the two gives true or false, and equal counts as full.
The answer is kept for the board to use.
Ossian notes the wind and whether there is fog.
The boat sails only when the wind is below his limit and there is no fog, both at once.
One true or false answer says whether the crossing can go.
The board has three words, and the two answers from before decide which.
A crossing that cannot sail is cancelled however full it is, whatever else is true.
The board shows exactly one word for the crossing.
Each passenger has an age, and the single fare is on the clipboard.
The youngest go free, children pay half, everyone else the single fare. A child of three is also under sixteen.
Bridie charges the fare in whole pence.
